thread:
anya: opened a PR for a small Console docs migration: renaming cost metric and fixing a mismatched cost widget. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/814. Rust telemetry example also broke smoke tests due to header/env var mismatch. can someone eyeball? cc @kevin @tom

docs-bot: PR 814 created by @anya — running presubmit checks (linkcheck, md-lint, snippets).

kevin: I'll take this in ~30m. Which panels are wrong?

anya: The ‘Cost by route’ widget and the latency scatter use the old metric key `cost_per_request`. I changed examples to `cost_per_unit` in YAML but missed panel formulas. Also linkcheck found an outdated anchor to presets.

prashant: I can push a commit that updates panel formulas to `sum(cost_per_unit)` and adds a tiny legacy conversion note: `legacy_cost_per_unit = cost_per_request * tokens_per_request`. Should stop the 100x-looking numbers.

tom: Rust snippet is in docs/sdks/rust/telemetry.md — it sets header `X-TELEMETRY-KEY` and env `TELEMETRY_KEY`. Our smoke harness expects `Telemetry-Auth` and `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY`. I'll swap them and run smoke.

anya: Thanks — added a comment in the PR about the anchor; will update permalinks.

docs-bot: presubmit results: md-lint passed, snippet-tests failed for rust-snippet:test-telemetry, linkcheck flagged docs/console/presets.md#old-presets-anchor (404).

tom: Ran the rust snippet update locally (changed header + env var) — tests pass now. pushing my patch to the PR branch. :thumbsup:

lia: I'll draft a short migration subsection under console/presets.md with an alias mapping table and a screenshot of the corrected widget. Keep it compact so non-breaking.

kevin: Plan: @prashant update panels, @tom push rust fix, @lia migration note + screenshot, @anya permalinks and merge once CI green. Post-merge we'll announce in #docs and include a short changelog entry.

anya: On it — will follow up with a small announcement draft for #docs. Thanks all!
